description: Start here: full-text search over the documentation indexed on this machine. Returns ranked passages, each with an id, title, heading path, citation_url, and text (long passages are shortened; read them in full with get_passage). Works with natural-language questions and code identifiers (getUserName, --dry-run, a.b.c). Results come from the current docs version; other_versions lists older versions that also matched, each with a path_prefix to pass back as path_prefix to search that version. Use list_sources to see which sources exist. Read-only.

path_prefix.description: Only passages whose URL (web sources) or root-relative path (local sources) starts with this prefix, for example a docs section or an other_versions path_prefix from a previous search.

query.description: What to look for: a question, keywords, or identifiers.

source_ids.description: Only search these source IDs, as returned by list_sources. Omit to search all sources.

name: search_passages
title: Search passages
